how_to_apply: Visit www.rrbapply.gov.in.
Find the application facility for CEN 09/2026 - Isolated Categories.
If you already created an RRB account for a previous CEN in 2024, 2025 or 2026, log in using the existing account credentials.
New applicants should select Create an Account.
Enter personal details exactly as recorded in the Class 10 certificate or equivalent record.
Provide an active personal email address and mobile number.
Complete account creation and the required verification steps.
Log in and select CEN 09/2026.
Choose one RRB and review the vacancies available under it.
Enter the educational qualifications and professional experience required for the selected posts.
Provide the applicable community, reservation and relaxation details.
Choose the preferred examination language.
Enter the order of preference for eligible posts and Railway Zones or Production Units.
Complete Aadhaar/DigiLocker verification where available and applicable.
Capture a live photograph through the application portal.
Upload the scanned signature according to the prescribed specifications.
Upload other mandatory documents, including the applicable SC/ST certificate when requesting a free railway travel pass.
Preview the application carefully.
Submit the application by 4 December 2026.
Pay the prescribed application fee by 6 December 2026.
Save or print the submitted application and payment acknowledgement.

Important: Only one application is permitted for CEN 09/2026. Submitting multiple applications to different or the same RRB can lead to rejection of all applications and debarment from future Railway recruitment examinations.
important_instructions: RRB CEN 09/2026 announces 191 isolated-category vacancies. Applications are open from 5 November to 4 December 2026. The application fee payment deadline is 6 December 2026. The modification window is 7 to 16 December 2026. Candidates may select only one RRB. Multiple applications can result in rejection and debarment. Educational qualifications must be completed by the application closing date. Candidates awaiting final results are ineligible. Age is calculated as on 1 January 2027. Post-specific medical standards are mandatory. The standard CBT contains 100 questions for 100 marks. Negative marking is one-third of the marks for each wrong answer. Junior Translator candidates must qualify in the additional Translation Test. Exam fee refunds depend on CBT attendance and the notified conditions. Live photo capture is mandatory during application. The scanned signature must meet the prescribed specifications. Official communication will be published through the RRB websites and registered email/mobile channels. All vacancies are provisional and may change.

content_sections.heading: RRB Isolated Category Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The Railway Recruitment Boards have issued the detailed Centralised Employment Notification No. 09/2026 for 191 isolated-category vacancies. The official 59-page PDF provides complete post-wise qualifications, age limits, initial pay, category and RRB-wise vacancies, examination fees, selection procedures, medical standards, CBT syllabus, application instructions and certificate formats. Official Notification PDF: Download RRB Isolated Category Recruitment 2026 CEN 09/2026

content_sections.heading: RRB Isolated Category Vacancy 2026 - 191 Posts
content_sections.text: CEN 09/2026 announces 191 vacancies across seven categories . Junior Translator (Hindi) has the highest number of vacancies with 79 posts, followed by Lab Assistant Grade III with 36. Important: Candidates must examine the post-wise and Railway Zone/Production Unit-wise vacancy distribution in Annexure B of the detailed notification before selecting an RRB. A chosen RRB may not have vacancies for every post category. The category-wise vacancy distribution is based on Annexure B. Ex-Servicemen and Persons with Benchmark Disabilities reservations are horizontal and included in the notified vacancies wherever applicable. RRB-wise and category-wise vacancies are provisional and may change according to Railway Administration requirements.

content_sections.heading: RRB Isolated Category Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The educational qualification differs substantially across the seven posts. Applicants must meet the specific academic and professional requirements listed in Annexure A by 4 December 2026 . Candidates must possess a university degree in Law and have at least three years of standing practice as a Pleader at Bar. Serving Railway employees with a Law degree may also apply if they have completed at least five years of service in any branch of Railway Administration, subject to the notification's conditions. Applicants must have a recognized Bachelor's degree in Law and five years of standing as an Advocate at Bar. Important: A Law degree alone is not sufficient. The prescribed professional practice requirement must also be satisfied. Candidates need a recognized university degree together with a Diploma in Public Relations, Advertising, Journalism or Mass Communication from a recognized institution or university. Two years of experience in a relevant field is desirable, not mandatory. Junior Translator applicants must satisfy one of the prescribed Master's degree language combinations involving Hindi and English, along with an additional translation qualification or experience. The academic requirement may be fulfilled through a recognized Master's degree in Hindi or English with the other language as a compulsory/elective subject or medium of examination at degree level, or through the alternative Master's degree language combinations specified in Annexure A. In addition, candidates must possess either: A recognized Diploma or Certificate Course in translation from Hindi to English and vice versa; or Two years of translation experience between Hindi and English in Central or State Government offices, including Government of India undertakings. Important: A general Master's degree or Hindi/English language proficiency alone does not automatically satisfy this post's eligibility conditions. Applicants must have graduation along with at least one of the following qualifications: Diploma in Labour or Social Welfare. Diploma in Labour Laws. LLB with papers in Labour Laws. Postgraduate Diploma in Personnel Management. MBA with papers in Personnel Management. MBA in Human Resources. Postgraduate Diploma in Human Resource Management with relevant Personnel Management papers from a Government-recognized institution. Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Psychology with at least 50% marks in aggregate . Specialization in Industrial, Organisational or Clinical Psychology; experience in counselling or guidance programmes; and working computer knowledge are desirable qualifications. Candidates must have passed Class 12 (+2 Stage) or an equivalent examination with Physics and Chemistry as subjects . This is the only post category in CEN 09/2026 for which the stated essential educational qualification is at the 12th-standard level. content_sections.heading: RRB Isolated Category Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The recruitment involves a single-stage Computer Based Test (CBT) , followed by a Translation Test for Junior Translator candidates, where applicable, and subsequent Document Verification and Medical Examination. Computer Based Test: Eligible candidates appear for the prescribed objective examination. Translation Test: Junior Translator (Hindi) candidates shortlisted from CBT must qualify in the translation test. Document Verification: Candidates are shortlisted according to merit, vacancy availability and applicable reservation rules. Medical Examination: Candidates must meet the medical standards applicable to their selected post. Final Empanelment: Subject to merit, qualifications, medical fitness and successful verification. RRBs reserve the right to conduct additional recruitment stages where necessary under the notification.

content_sections.heading: RRB Isolated Category CBT Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The standard CBT consists of 100 objective questions carrying 100 marks , with a duration of 90 minutes. Eligible candidates using a scribe receive 120 minutes. The notified subject-wise distribution is indicative and may vary slightly in the actual question paper. These are minimum eligibility percentages, not guaranteed selection cut-offs. A relaxation of two marks may be allowed for PwBD candidates where a shortage exists against reserved PwBD vacancies, as prescribed.

content_sections.heading: RRB Junior Translator Hindi Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Junior Translator (Hindi) candidates will appear for a specialized CBT followed by a qualifying Translation Test. The CBT is designed to assess knowledge of both Hindi and English. At least 50% of the questions will assess language proficiency, including approximately 20% English and 30% Hindi. Remaining questions cover General Knowledge, General Intelligence, Simple Arithmetic and basic computer knowledge. Important: Translation Test marks are not added to the final merit score. Candidates who fail to obtain 60% in the Translation Test will not be considered for further selection even if they performed well in CBT.

content_sections.heading: RRB Isolated Category Syllabus 2026
content_sections.text: The CBT includes common subjects and post-specific Professional Ability questions. Detailed professional syllabi are provided in Annexures IX to XV of CEN 09/2026. Mathematics: Number system, percentages, ratio and proportion, algebra, geometry, mensuration, profit and loss, time and work, time and distance, interest and elementary statistics. Reasoning: Analogies, number series, coding-decoding, syllogism, relationships, Venn diagrams, decision-making, classification, data interpretation and analytical reasoning. General Awareness: Current affairs, Indian history, geography, Constitution, economy, sports, environment and scientific developments. General Science: Physics, Chemistry and Life Sciences up to Class 10 CBSE level. Professional Ability: Questions related to the academic or professional qualification prescribed for the selected post. Candidates should study the relevant syllabus annexure rather than relying on a generic Railway examination syllabus.

content_sections.heading: RRB Isolated Category Medical Standards 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy the medical fitness standards prescribed for their post. Failure to meet the required standard may result in rejection without an alternative appointment. Important: The medical standards include prescribed visual acuity and fitness requirements. Candidates who have undergone LASIK or other refractive surgery should check Annexure VII and the applicable medical conditions before applying.

content_sections.heading: RRB Isolated Category Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates can apply for CEN 09/2026 through the official Railway Recruitment Board application portal from 5 November to 4 December 2026 . Apply Online: RRB Recruitment Application Portal Notification Number: CEN 09/2026. Application Last Date: 4 December 2026 at 11:59 PM. Fee Payment Last Date: 6 December 2026 at 11:59 PM. Important: Candidates can choose only one RRB. Once selected, the RRB cannot be changed during the application process or modification window.

content_sections.text: Visit www.rrbapply.gov.in . Find the application facility for CEN 09/2026 - Isolated Categories . If you already created an RRB account for a previous CEN in 2024, 2025 or 2026, log in using the existing account credentials. New applicants should select Create an Account. Enter personal details exactly as recorded in the Class 10 certificate or equivalent record. Provide an active personal email address and mobile number. Enter the educational qualifications and professional experience required for the selected posts. Provide the applicable community, reservation and relaxation details. Choose the preferred examination language. Enter the order of preference for eligible posts and Railway Zones or Production Units. Complete Aadhaar/DigiLocker verification where available and applicable. Capture a live photograph through the application portal. Upload the scanned signature according to the prescribed specifications. Upload other mandatory documents, including the applicable SC/ST certificate when requesting a free railway travel pass. Preview the application carefully. Submit the application by 4 December 2026 . Pay the prescribed application fee by 6 December 2026 . Save or print the submitted application and payment acknowledgement. Important: Only one application is permitted for CEN 09/2026. Submitting multiple applications to different or the same RRB can lead to rejection of all applications and debarment from future Railway recruitment examinations.

content_sections.heading: RRB Isolated Category Photograph and Signature Requirements
content_sections.text: The application system captures a live photograph. Candidates are not required to upload an existing passport-size photograph during registration. Use a computer webcam or mobile front camera. Choose a plain white background. Wear non-white clothing, preferably a plain dark colour. Ensure the entire face is visible and centered. Do not wear spectacles, caps or masks while capturing the photograph. Follow the portal's positioning and lighting instructions. Do not photograph a printed or digital copy of an existing photograph. Important: Blurred, incomplete, incorrectly formatted or non-standard signatures may lead to application rejection. Eligible SC/ST candidates requesting a free railway travel pass must upload their valid category certificate in PDF format, with a file size below 400 KB .
